name: show-and-tell-monorepo
description: ShowAndTell - Standalone JavaScript Screen Recording SDK and Demo

scripts.build: npm run build:sdk && npm run build:react
scripts.test: npm run test:sdk && npm run test:react
scripts.lint: tsc --noEmit --project packages/sdk/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit --project packages/server/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit --project packages/react/tsconfig.json
scripts.start: npm run build && npm run build:server && npm run demo
